name: Tool Call Accuracy
description: Composite of tool selection, input accuracy, output utilisation, call success, and tool efficiency. Aggregates 5 sub-LLM judges into a single score representing the agent's tool-use quality.

expectedInputs.description: The user's request that triggered the tool calls.
The sequence of tool invocations the agent made, including arguments and results.
Optional ground-truth actions for stricter scoring.
